purpose: Two user-requested manual comparisons: no Lumen at 10 FPS with original motion blur, and original Lumen/frame scheduling with motion blur disabled.

failedConfigOnlyAttempt.reason: t.MaxFPS=10 was logged as applied but actual submission FPS remained 38.7969. The final A package adds an explicit diagnostic RAF gate; the underlying setting override cause remains unconfirmed.

manualObservations.source: User feedback after sequential tests in the same visible browser tab.

noLumen10FPS.result: No obvious shaking with Lumen disabled, original motion blur retained, and actual 10 FPS.

lumenWithoutMotionBlur.result: No obvious shaking with Lumen enabled, motion blur disabled, and original frame scheduling.
lumenWithoutMotionBlur.userFeedback: lumen开启，动态模糊关闭，无明显抖动。基本可以确定是动态模糊和lumen混合下导致的问题了

manualObservations.conclusion: The reported severe shaking requires the original Lumen-plus-motion-blur conditions in these comparisons. Disabling either effect removed obvious shaking in the user observations. Different frame schedules prevent these tests from isolating the specific implementation defect.

boundary: Functional configuration checks passed. Same WASM/runtime and Cook scene; A additionally changes its private worker RAF scheduler. Submission timestamps are not physical presentation times. Motion blur internals and the precise Lumen-dependent failure mechanism remain unverified; no implementation repair is claimed.
